prompt: Who had the best career batting average out of every player to hit a home run in the 2002 World Series matchup between the Anaheim Angeles and San Francisco Giants?
answer: **Barry Bonds** had the best career batting average among the players who hit a home run in the 2002 World Series matchup. He finished his career with a **.298 batting average**, higher than Jeff Kent (.290), Tim Salmon (.282), and the other home-run hitters.
